scg.text: Karona was born when Kamahl's Soul Reaper killed Akroma, Phage and Zagorka at the apex of their battle and fused their souls, and the armies stopped fighting to worship her.
She decided she must be a goddess, summoned portals seeking her equal, and learned that Gaea was the true World Soul, which sent her into rage and madness.
She encased the Numena in stone, blasted Averru with pure magic, and built an army to destroy those who opposed her, annihilating the city of Aphetto.
In the end Sash and Waistcoat, on Lord Macht's instruction, drove the Mirari sword through her, and on Argentum she regressed to Jeska.

tsp.text: Karona wandered the Blind Eternities, where locals on a plane of yellow skies rejected her and Serra told her Dominaria was her true home.

After Yawgmoth urged her to stay at the remnants of Phyrexia, she was warned by Sash and Waistcoat and left, and on a metal plane she recognized Lord Macht, forgave his guilt over the Mirari and was transported back to Dominaria.
She then gathered an army, waged Karona's War across Otaria, destroying cities, and killed the three Numena one by one.
On Lord Macht's advice, Sash and Waistcoat pierced her with the Mirari Sword and Macht took her to Argentum, where she died, regressing into the three women, with Jeska surviving.
